raw_translation: Escolha preço-a-rendimento para descontar o cupom agendado e os pagamentos do principal, ou escolha rendimento-a-preço para resolver numericamente o rendimento anual nominal que corresponde a um preço de mercado.Choose price-from-yield to discount the scheduled coupon and principal payments, or choose yield-from-price to numerically solve the nominal annual yield that matches a market price.
source: Enter the face value, annual coupon rate, years to maturity and coupon frequency. Choose price-from-yield to discount the scheduled coupon and principal payments, or choose yield-from-price to numerically solve the nominal annual yield that matches a market price.
translation: Escolha preço-a-rendimento para descontar o cupom agendado e os pagamentos do principal, ou escolha rendimento-a-preço para resolver numericamente o rendimento anual nominal que corresponde a um preço de mercado.Choose price-from-yield to discount the scheduled coupon and principal payments, or choose yield-from-price to numerically solve the nominal annual yield that matches a market price.
